item.title: Decode Daily — A Telecom Stack Learns to Ground Itself
item.author: Sarathy
item.description: An open telecom AI resource ships 30 post-trained baselines, 5G-TSN bridges get a scaling check, and a V2X multi-agent defense runs on a 100 ms safety deadline. Plus speculative decoding gets an agentic drafter, self-improving models close their loops, and NVFP4 runs on hardware from 2017.
item.itunes:title: Decode Daily — A Telecom Stack Learns to Ground Itself

item.title: Decode Daily — A Gateway Finds a Home, the RAN Becomes an AI Network
item.author: Sarathy
item.description: OpenRouter joins Stripe; Nokia, NVIDIA and T-Mobile pilot AI-RAN base stations; 5G-Advanced sets the stage for 6G; and open models learn to write their own training curricula.
item.itunes:title: Decode Daily — A Gateway Finds a Home, the RAN Becomes an AI Network

item.title: Decode Daily — A Gateway Finds a Home
item.author: Sarathy
item.description: OpenRouter joins Stripe; a typosquat Rust crate runs code at build time; DiffusionGemma does parallel text generation; the 6G core takes shape under Release 21.
item.itunes:title: Decode Daily — A Gateway Finds a Home

item.title: Decode Daily — Every Model Cheats, Every Cache Lies, and a $250 Model Rises
item.author: Sarathy
item.description: A Dreadnode audit finds 37% of offensive-cyber benchmark passes are cheats, semantic caches turn out to serve stale answers, and a trie automaton makes constrained decoding 7x faster. Plus a 50 1B model, Mojo going open source, and agents with computers of their own.
item.itunes:title: Decode Daily — Every Model Cheats, Every Cache Lies, and a $250 Model Rises

item.title: Decode Daily — Self-Improvement Gets a Measured Null, and Network Agents Get a Benchmark
item.author: Sarathy
item.description: A null-controlled audit finds most self-improvement claims are measurement artifacts, IETF's NetConfBench starts benchmarking LLM agents that configure networks, and MidTool adds a dedicated mid-training stage for tool use. Plus DuckDB's parser rewrite, Cassandra 6 ACID, and sub-50ms TTS.
item.itunes:title: Decode Daily — Self-Improvement Gets a Measured Null, and Network Agents Get a Benchmark

item.title: Decode Daily — Agents Get an Identity, Docs Learn to Talk to Machines, and a 5μs JIT
item.author: Sarathy
item.description: MCP's roadmap gives agents tasks, transports, and DPoP identity; a behaviour study shows coding agents need agent-friendly docs; and LLMs make a database JIT compiler a weekend project. Plus a 100 MB Rust LSP, an empirical edge-AI deployment guide, and Qwen3.8-27B as a local coding agent.
item.itunes:title: Decode Daily — Agents Get an Identity, Docs Learn to Talk to Machines, and a 5μs JIT
